title: Of her dearest, daintiest
paragraphs: Yes, if you would quite believe me, You sweet maidens: She has lost it!
Oh, what a shame about that other dear leg!
Where can it now be, sorrowing forsaken?
Perhaps in fear before an Angry, blonde-maned Lion-monster? Or perhaps even Gnawed off, broken in pieces – Pitiable, alas! alas! broken in pieces! Selah.
Oh do not weep, Gentle hearts!
Do not weep, you Date-hearts! Milk-bosoms!
Be a man, Suleika! Courage! Courage!
– Or would perhaps Something bracing, heart-bracing,
Blow, blow again, Bellows of virtue!
Roar like a moral lion Before the daughters of the desert!
For virtuous howling, You dearest maidens, Is loved best of all by European ardour, European appetite!
And here I stand now, As European, I cannot do otherwise, so help me God!52 Amen!
Deserts grow: woe to him who harbours deserts!
